name: value-gate
note: Predeclared 2026-11-03 before any game (board row 4, first bar; Jerry approved trying the learned-value lane). Self-play of the served planner_offer_accept (four copies), rows at the start of every own turn labelled by that seat's eventual win. Learned = fixed logistic fit on the 38 value_features plus the served leaf for the seat and the largest opponent leaf (/100), train split only, games weighted equally. PASS iff zero truncated games and the game-clustered bootstrap 95% lower bound of (learned AUC minus the better of the served leaf AUC and the shared-score AUC) on the 200 test games is > 0. Test seeds 2501000-2501199 are not read until training is complete. Prior context: outcome-value v1 passed a log-loss gate against a points/production baseline but its planner integrations failed DEV (-28 to -37 pp, 32 seeds); this gate compares against the served leaf itself. A pass licenses a predeclared integration screen vs the served bot at the standard +.05 bar; a fail parks the linear state model.
